title: Fun things to do with a dead animal
summary: A short humorous piece from the Black Sheep series, numbered 3 of 5 in Volume 1, written under the pen name Mongrel. It is a tongue-in-cheek list of six 'fun' activities for a deceased pet, most of them grotesque and absurd: a backyard game of 'Hot Dead Animal' played with a garden hose stuffed into the carcass, a dust-sweeping tail, a welcome doormat, a dartboard with scoring for each body part, a makeshift duffel bag, and a prank that hides a rotting animal in the home air-conditioning. The author admits a preference for cats because of their flexibility and writes in a deliberately crude, irreverent voice aimed at shock value and laughs. The text is a piece of gallows humor and joke writing rather than a serious guide, and it is best read as a deliberately offensive parody of household handyman advice and family entertainment tips.
